I think a fundamental challenge of galleries and generally contemporary art moving forward is how to engage audiences outside of those spaces; how to make general audiences feel more comfortable engaging with art. Ninety-nine percent of people are never going to walk into a white cube but I think they would go to a Basel Social Club or a Tokyo Jazz Club. That's what makes them exciting directions: they feel like they have the opportunity to grow and change things. To make the experience of art itself different.
